summaries.shodan: Search internet-connected hosts, open ports, DNS and CVEs through Shodan, with a credit ledger that stops before your monthly query credits run out.
summaries.hermes-tripo: Make 3D models with Tripo from text, photos or four views, then rig, animate, split into parts, re-UV and convert them for Godot, Unity, Unreal, Roblox, AR or printing. Results open in an interactive 3D viewer inside Hermes Desktop, with a library that shows where each model came from, and every credit-spending call asks first with its cost.

hermes-glyphwake.summary: Click the empty chat in Hermes Desktop and watch a wave of ASCII characters decode into a wordmark.

hermes-plugin-resume-session.summary: Pick up recent Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions inside Hermes, with a compact pick-up card and the foreign transcript kept as inert history.

Flymes.summary: An experiment: a simulated fruit fly connectome, built from real fly brain wiring, picks the agent's next tool call, with a live Desktop panel to watch it decide.

hermes-osint-map.summary: A live OSINT globe for Hermes Desktop: earthquakes, disasters, aircraft, satellites, news incidents and official traffic cameras from public, keyless sources, with country dossiers, domain recon and briefings Hermes can write for you.

hermes-threatmap.summary: A dithered 3D globe of live cyberattacks inside Hermes Desktop, from Check Point's public threat map feed. Unofficial and for personal, non-commercial use; a demo mode runs without the live feed.
